name: Shital Quiz Cloner for LearnDash
author: Shital Marakana

sections.description:
Shital Quiz Cloner for LearnDash allows you to quickly duplicate existing quizzes in LearnDash with just one click. This plugin is designed to save time for course creators, instructors, and administrators who frequently need to reuse quiz structures.

Instead of manually recreating quizzes, questions, and settings, this plugin helps you clone everything instantly, improving productivity and workflow efficiency.

Features

  • One-click quiz cloning functionality
  • Seamless integration with LearnDash
  • Preserves quiz structure and settings
  • Simple and user-friendly interface
  • Saves time for course creators and administrators

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • LearnDash LMS plugin installed and activated

Usage

  1. Go to the WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to “Quiz Cloner” menu.
  3. Select the quiz you want to duplicate.
  4. Click on “Clone Quiz”.
  5. A new cloned quiz will be created automatically.

Support

For support or feature requests, please contact the plugin author.

Note : If you like the plugin please rate it.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the LearnDash plugin, then activate it. (https://www.learndash.com)
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shital-quiz-cloner-for-learndash directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to ‘Quiz Cloner’ from the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Select a quiz and click on “Clone Quiz” to create a duplicate.
